verdict.rationale: Registering SSH keys for Git authentication is a fair question for a self-hosted Git service, so the axis applies. No item in the evidence pack mentions SSH key registration or SSH-based Git authentication. The only SSH mention is a user tunnelling to the web UI over an SSH port-forward, which is a user-side workaround and unrelated to account keys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register SSH keys on my account to authenticate Git operations
